text: Hello everyone, welcome to our English class.Nice to see you.In today's lesson, you will review what you have learned in Unit 5 and Unit 6.You will describe dream jobs in the simple future tense, and you will also describe the clothes and scenery in different seasons.Please check if you have your student's book, your worksheet, your notebook and pen with you.Are you ready?OK, let's start.Today we have a new friend called Angela.She is from Australia.She wants to take a photograph with the magic camera.Now, Angela has got a note about her possible future from the magic camera.Please take out your worksheet and write down her possible future according to the information from the magic camera and her present condition.You will have one minute.Ready?Start.My student Jimmy wants to share his writing.Let's see if he has done a good job.According to the magic camera, Angela will be 175 cm tall and she will weigh 57 kg.She will be tall, slim and beautiful.She will possibly be a model in 15 years' time, because she is good at giving shows on the stage.Jimmy, you have done a good job.Now we know Angela will possibly be a model.But what would she like to be?Look at the picture.It's about Angela's dream job.What does she want to do?She wants to design clothes.Can you guess her dream job?A fashion designer.Right.It means 时装设计师.She would like to be a fashion designer.Please read after me.Fashion designer.What should a fashion designer be good at?Yes, he or she should be good at drawing.So what does Angela have to practice more?Right, she has to practice drawing more.Let's move on.Well, Peter is Angela's pen friend in Shanghai.They are now chatting via an online application.Chat via an online application means 通过线上应用软件聊天.Now listen to the dialogue between Peter and Angela and take the information you hear on your worksheet.Hi, Angela.Hi, Peter.I'm doing a project on the seasonal changes in different countries.Can you tell me something about your country, Angela?Of course.Summer in Australia starts in late November.It ends in early February.When is winter in Australia?Winter in our country is from June to late August.I see.Do you wear school uniforms in Australia?Some of the students in Australia wear school uniforms.Students in our school don't wear uniforms.What do you wear at school then?Well, it's very hot in summer.I usually wear a t-shirt, a skirt or a dress.Boys usually wear t-shirts and shorts.What about in winter?It's cold in winter.Boys wear shirts with long sleeves and trousers.Girls wear blouses with long sleeves and trousers.Some wear skirts or dresses too.What did you hear in the dialogue?Yes, seasons and months and school uniforms.Now please listen again and fill in the table on your worksheet.Let's check.Summer in Australia is from late November to early February.Boys wear t-shirts and shorts.Girls wear t-shirts, skirts or dresses.And winter in Australia is from June to late August.Good job!Now can you describe what Angela and her classmates wear in summer and winter according to the table?You will have two minutes to finish the task.Okay, here is my student Emily's writing.Let's read it together and find out if she has done a good job.Winter in Australia from June to late August.Angela and her classmates don't wear uniforms at school.In summer, boys wear t-shirts and shorts.In winter, boys wear shirts with long sleeves and trousers.I think Emily has done a good job.Do you agree with me?Now Peter knows what students wear in Australia.Angela also wants to know what Chinese students wear at school.Peter has collected some photos of Rose Garden School uniforms in the past.Angela is interested in them.Here are the photos of Rose Garden School uniforms in the past.The word war is the past tense of wear.Can you describe the uniforms to Angela?You will have one minute to prepare.Well, here is Emily's writing again.In summer, boys wore white t-shirts with short sleeves, blue trousers and black shoes.Girls wore white t-shirts with short sleeves, blue skirts and black shoes.In winter, boys wore blue and white jackets, blue trousers, black socks and white shoes.Girls wore blue and white jackets, blue trousers, white socks and white shoes.Well done, Emily!Now we know Angela doesn't need to wear uniforms at school.However, Peter must wear uniforms at school.So Angela asks Peter, if you don't need to wear uniforms at school, what will you wear?Peter says, in summer, I will wear a t-shirt and a pair of shorts.In winter, I will wear a coat and a pair of trousers.I will also wear a scarf.Besides school uniforms, Peter wants to know something about the seasonal changes in Australia.So Angela promises to send him an email about this.Now please read Angela's email about the seasonal changes in Canberra.Canberra is the capital of Australia, in Chinese, Canberra.OK, ready?Now I think you have a general idea about the seasonal changes in Canberra.Can you describe them according to the photos?Have you finished?Jimmy would like to share his work.Let's read it together.In spring, the trees in the streets have lots of small white and pink flowers.In summer, people usually go swimming every day.They usually go to the beach in January.In autumn, the trees are all orange and brown.In winter, it snows in some places.Often the sky is very blue and there are not any clouds.You see, Jimmy has done a wonderful job.I think you must have done a great job too.Now that we have learned a lot about Angela, can you write a passage about Angela?You will have three minutes to finish the task.You will have three minutes to prepare.I think you have finished your writing.Let's read Emily's passage together.Angela doesn't wear uniforms at school.In summer, she often wears a t-shirt, a skirt or a dress.In winter, she often wears a blouse with long sleeves and a pair of trousers.Angela lives in Canberra.It's a beautiful place.It's warm and sometimes it rains.In summer, she usually goes to the beach in January.It's windy there and the sea is very cool.It's her favorite season.In winter, she goes skiing in the snowy mountains.Is Emily's writing good?Yes, and I believe you've also done a great job.Today, you have reviewed how to describe dream jobs in the simple future tense.You have also reviewed how to describe the clothes and the scenery in different seasons.Please finish your homework on your homework sheet after class.That's all.Goodbye, boys and girls.
